coordinate.basis: centre of retained source footprint bounds, Mercator metres; candidate matching documented separately

assets.heightDatum: Source heights where available; otherwise storeys x 3.05 m estimate. Roof plant stays inside known source-height envelopes; special silhouette dimensions are documented separately. All building bases at local floor zero.

supports: identity and source provenance; no texture rights asserted

assets.geometryProvenance: Retained real building footprint polygons from data/buildings.sqlite; no modification to database

modelingEstimates.facade: Procedural window ribbons, piers and mineral colours; not photo-measured
modelingEstimates.roof: Setback rooftop plant from inset footprint; estimated
modelingEstimates.specialSilhouetteProportions: Dome, arch, eaves and structural colour accents are source-informed visual estimates; see linked dimension sources where available
modelingEstimates.groundDatum: shared floor plane, local terrain queried at model anchor

estimatedDetails: Footprint shape and placement follow the retained source geometry.
Window arrangement, materials, roof details and missing heights are estimates; not surveyed architecture.
Source building records and matching evidence are in docs/APARTMENT_400_PROVENANCE.json.

genericCorrection.operation: Exact triangle partition; unchanged vertex attributes, materials and original terrain anchor.
